name: a registered DID derives from its own published key
description: For every DID the registry resolves with a publicKeyHex, the method-specific identifier must be the first 8 bytes of SHA-256 over that key.
rationale: Section 2.2 ties the identifier to the key. A registry that issues identifiers from another source produces DIDs that cannot be checked against their own key material.
known_deviation: derivation::identifiers are not derived from the key
